Plot local overlap for CATE and CLATE fits

Source: R/plot-overlap.R
plot_overlap.Rd

Two views of treatment overlap inside the DNN neighbourhoods of a cate_dnn() fit. type = "mass" shows the weighted treated and control mass per target (for simplex weights the two masses partition one, so the treated mass is the local treated share) with dotted guides and shaded warning bands outside share_limits. type = "propensity" shows the local weighted propensity distribution: weighted densities per selected target when observation-level propensities are available, and the weighted mean with a q10–q90 whisker summary otherwise.

Usage

plot_overlap(
  object,
  type = c("mass", "propensity"),
  share_limits = c(0.1, 0.9),
  treatment = NULL,
  propensity = NULL,
  targets = NULL,
  instrument = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A cate_result or clate_result with the weight matrix W stored (the default).

type

One of "mass" or "propensity".

share_limits

Numeric length-2 vector (default c(0.1, 0.9)); treated shares outside this range are flagged as overlap warnings.

treatment

Optional 0/1 vector of length n; used when the fit does not store treatment (matrix interface). For CLATE use instrument.

propensity

Optional numeric vector of length n in (0, 1); used when the fit does not store propensities.

targets

Optional integer vector of target ids for the density view (defaults to the first/median-n_eff/last subset above eight targets).

instrument

Optional 0/1 instrument vector for a CLATE fit whose instrument record is unavailable. Stored instrument data take precedence.

...

Ignored; reserved for future options.

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

Inputs resolve in a fixed order: components stored on the fit (t_vec/e from the data-frame interface), then the treatment/ propensity arguments, then an actionable error. Nothing is recomputed from first stages.

For clate_dnn() fits these same panels describe instrument overlap: the arms are A=1 and A=0 and the propensity is P(A=1|V). Both are retained by the CLATE fit. Treatment uptake D is not used as the instrument arm.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  set.seed(1)
  n <- 120
  df <- data.frame(X1 = rnorm(n), X2 = rnorm(n))
  df$e <- plogis(0.5 * df$X1)
  df$T <- as.integer(runif(n) < df$e)
  df$m0 <- df$X1
  df$m1 <- df$X1 + 1
  df$Y <- ifelse(df$T == 1, df$m1, df$m0) + rnorm(n, sd = 0.3)
  fit <- cate_dnn(
    data = df, x_cols = c("X1", "X2"), y_col = "Y", t_col = "T",
    e_col = "e", m0_col = "m0", m1_col = "m1",
    X0 = cbind(seq(-1, 1, length.out = 5), 0),
    k = 1L, s = 15L, se = FALSE
  )
  plot_overlap(fit, type = "mass")
}
